question: The parent passes an inline onChange and re-renders. The Effect lists [roomId, onChange]. What happens?
options: The Effect re-syncs every parent render
say: The parent passes an inline on change and re-renders. The Effect lists room id and on change. What happens?
explanation: An inline function is new each render, so the dependency changes and the Effect re-synchronizes every time.
explainSay: It re-syncs every time, because the inline function is new each render.
